Munmun Dutta Addresses Marriage Speculation, Expresses Preference for Single Life

Munmun Dutta, known for her role as Babita Ji in 'Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah', recently shared a travel reel on Instagram, accompanied by a caption addressing speculation about her personal life. She stated that she will not marry, expressing a preference for remaining single despite others' comments. Dutta's post indicates her comfort with an independent lifestyle.
